{{Top|leg}}
The '''Adsila Rifts''', also known as the '''Adsila Ridges''', were an area of geological instability in the [[Doaba Badlands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. The area was known for [[sand well]]s, [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]], and [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]]. Rifts crisscrossed the area, with some twenty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] deep and leading to underground [[Magma/Legends|lava]] chambers. Subterranean plates would shift to expose and seal the rifts.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>

During the initial colonization of Socorro, one of the [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ships]] was forced to deviate from their proposed landing site, and landed in the area that would become known as the Adsila Rifts. Several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after landing, contact with the settlers was lost. [[Scout/Legends|Scout]] [[Kirr Cyrs]] investigated the area and found evidence of the seismic instability in the area. The settlers attributed the settlement's loss to a sand well.<ref name="BSS" />

The area was named after [[Adsila]], a woman from Old [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] mythology who controlled the inevitable dissension and uncertainty of life. The [[Nhar'qual Rift]] was one of the most famous rifts, and was rumored to be bottomless.<ref name="BSS" />
